title: platostoma dilungense
intro: Platostoma dilungense, commonly known as Kembang Sepatu, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae, native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Platostoma dilungense include antiviral and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for viral infections and fever. The bioactive constituents of Platostoma dilungense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
